ability.name: GPO, Trusts, Delegation, and LAPS Enumeration
ability.description: Performs ADSI checks for Group Policies, trusts, unconstrained delegation, and LAPS-enabled hosts.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $searcherGPO = [adsisearcher]'(objectCategory=groupPolicyContainer)'; $searcherGPO.FindAll() | ForEach-Object { $_.Properties.displayname } | Out-File -FilePath $d\gpos.txt; [System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectory.Domain]::GetCurrentDomain().DomainTrusts | Out-File -FilePath $d\trusts.txt; $searcherDel = [adsisearcher]'(&(objectCategory=computer)(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=524288))'; $searcherDel.FindAll() | ForEach-Object { $_.Properties.dnshostname } | Out-File -FilePath $d\delegation.txt; $searcherLAPS = [adsisearcher]'(ms-mcs-AdmPwd=*)'; $searcherLAPS.FindAll() | ForEach-Object { $_.Properties.name } | Out-File -FilePath $d\laps.txt } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\ad_components_out.txt

rationale: Leverages built-in ADSI to pull domain topology information safely and silently.
